name: Risk Assessment
description: Ability to evaluate and communicate security risk through structured scoring methodologies. Covers likelihood and impact assessment, risk rating frameworks (CVSS v3.1/v4.0, OWASP Risk Rating, custom), the distinction between technical severity scores and contextual risk, and contextual risk analysis for different audiences.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to risk assessment concepts

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands basic risk concepts: likelihood, impact, severity
evidence: Can explain the difference between likelihood and impact
Can describe the basic structure of at least one risk scoring framework (e.g., CVSS base metrics)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can assign risk ratings under supervision using established methodology
evidence: Correctly applies CVSS or lab risk methodology to findings
Risk ratings reviewed and approved by senior staff

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assigns accurate, contextual risk ratings
evidence: Consistent, well-justified risk ratings across engagements
Can explain ratings to technical and non-technical audiences
Handles edge cases (chained vulnerabilities, compensating controls)

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex risk scenarios; reviews risk assessments; adapts methodology
evidence: Assesses risk in complex, multi-system environments
Reviews and calibrates risk ratings across the team
Adapts risk methodology for specific client contexts or standards

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines risk methodology; contributes to industry standards
evidence: Designed or significantly evolved the lab's risk assessment framework
Trains teams on risk assessment methodology
Contributes to external standards or industry guidance on risk

assessment_methods.description: Review risk ratings across 3 recent engagement reports for accuracy and consistency
Scenario-based assessment: assign and justify risk ratings for complex multi-vulnerability findings
